en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play basketball
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Let's warm up a bit

You're rather brave to challenge me at a game
of basketball!

Though my physical strength is approximate
to that of a strong senior citizen...

My basketball skills are the same as an MVP
of a girls elementary school basketball team!

You'll never get possession of the ball
from me! Not even once!
<CLT=cltMIND>That is oddly specific.
H-How...unwholesome!

Not even Professor Idabashi has seen me
nude!

<CLT=cltMIND>...What counts as
"naked" for Keebo?
<CLT=cltMIND>Like...his internal circuits?

Yes, it is important to warm up before
engaging in strenuous exercise.
Let's start with some stretches!

We should take our time warming up so we
don't hurt our backs!

Thanks to my strong AI, I never make the
same mistake twice!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
